about_the_game:
Dark Mass is a first-person psychological horror game that immerses you in the eerie silence of the deep ocean, where time stands still and forgotten horrors await. Play as Alice, a deep-sea explorer who, alongside her brother Reed, discovers the remains of a shipwreck unearthed after an earthquake. But beneath the wreckage lies something far more disturbing: a sunken manor, untouched despite the passing of centuries, waiting to be discovered.

Venturing inside, Alice soon realizes she isn't alone. An implacable presence lurks in the shadows, bound to the manor by a dark curse.

To escape, Alice must uncover its tragic past, solve puzzles based on real historical torture rituals, and make moral decisions that define her fate.

Key Features:

  • Thalassophobia: The first horror game set entirely underwater, where vertical exploration and environmental physics add new layers of tension. Leveraging the fear of deep waters to deliver an intense, profound, and novel horror experience.

  • Narrative Exploration with Choices: Communicate with your brother Reed through a fully Spanish-voiced walkie-talkie system as you unravel the secrets hidden in the depths.

  • Disturbing Ritual Puzzles: Solve unique, unsettling challenges based on inquisitorial tortures to unveil the mansion’s mysteries.

  • A Terrifying Presence: Avoid and overcome a monstrous entity with a tragic past, trapped within the manor for centuries.

  • Decisions That Shape Your Fate: Your actions matter. Choices you make influence how Alice’s story unfolds and concludes.

  • Unreal Engine 5: The game features unprecedented realism and detail of the ocean environment and its marine life.

Will you escape from the depths or become another lost soul in the abyss?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or equivalent / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel: Core i5-12400 or equivalent / AMD: Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3060 / Radeon RX 6700 XT or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: Dark Mass is a fully underwater horror game. Explore the ruins of a sunken manor and flee from a curse trapped within for centuries. Your choices will decide if you escape or join the lost souls of the abyss.
